new_findings.title: Storytime narrator delete-output lacks Cloud Storage generation precondition
current_safeguards: bound job owner/session/script and terminal status check
transaction commits derivativeAccessState REVOKED and outputDeletionState PENDING before Storage call
post-delete transaction rechecks stored artifactPath before setting COMPLETE
gap: GCS file.delete uses ignoreNotFound:true without ifGenerationMatch
same object path may refer to a newer immutable storage generation between fence and delete
post-delete condition checks only artifactPath and can remain unchanged after same-path object replacement
original Storage generation and object owner metadata not pinned by this function
new_findings.counterexample: Jobs PR170 privateMediaDelivery.ts deleteOwnedLifeMovieArtifact uses metadata generation, required owner/job hash markers and file.delete({ignoreNotFound:true,ifGenerationMatch:generation}); narrator deleteOutput does not call it.
new_findings.source_evidence_status: 16/16 static original source assertions PASS; no actual Cloud Storage race execution
new_findings.hypothesis: Without a generation precondition, a replacement of the same Storage path could cause deletion of a different current generation. Actual feasibility depends on writer IAM, object lifecycle and bucket version semantics; no incident claimed.
new_findings.required_fix: Make narrator output deletion compare immutable job-bound generation and object identity; use GCS conditional delete; retain PENDING on mismatch, 412 or unknown metadata; independently review cleanup retry/idempotency and no early COMPLETE.
new_findings.negative_test: Synthetic narrator job output generation g1, interleave object write at same path with g2 after PENDING; attempted delete g1 must NOT delete g2, must retain PENDING and require reconciliation.
new_findings.ownership: Jobs narrator/private media owner with Storytime+Privacy reviewer

new_findings.title: Jobs owner deletion fence treats missing documents differently from malformed present documents
new_findings.observed: Only existing local owner and canonical deletion fence documents must have explicit false status. If both documents are absent, the helper itself does not throw. Source smoke tests start from no fences and expect valid delivery; malformed present fields deny.
new_findings.interpretation: Possible intended default for not-deleted users, not automatically vulnerability. Distinguish absence of deletion tombstone from independent affirmative permission to use original recorded memory; canonical signed grant remains separate.
new_findings.next_action: Explicitly document owner-deletion tombstone provisioning/absence policy, migration for absent or orphaned records, and original-source grants; test missing, malformed, deleted, revoked and created-during-stream cases.
